definitions.gloss: traversing; trekking through; completing a route on foot
definitions.explanation: Walking or hiking through an entire route, trail, or area from start to finish. Implies accomplishment and physical effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏破|とうは}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I completed the entire course on foot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧アルプス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縦走|じゅうそう}⟦ルート→ルート：11250_ruuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏破|とうは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧だ。
examples.english: My dream is to traverse the ridge route of the Japanese Alps.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{四国|しこく}→四国：21447_shikoku⟧⟦お{遍路|へんろ}→お遍路：19059_ohenro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{八十八|はちじゅうはち}か{所|しょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すべて{踏破|とうは}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He spent half a year completing all 88 temples of the Shikoku pilgrimage.

notes:
Combines {踏|とう} (to tread, to step on) and {破|は} (to break through). Carries a strong sense of achievement — not just walking, but conquering a challenging route. Often used in mountaineering and long-distance hiking contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧⟦ルート→ルート：11250_ruuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏破|とうは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to complete the entire route
- ⟦{山脈|さんみゃく}→山脈：07856_sanmyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏破|とうは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to traverse a mountain range
- {踏破|とうは}⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧ — distance covered on foot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {縦走|じゅうそう} — ridge traverse (specifically hiking along mountain ridges)
- ⟦{完走|かんそう}→完走：16981_kansou⟧ — completing a race (running, not walking)
- ⟦{走破|そうは}→走破：22108_souha⟧ — completing a route by running or driving
